info.name: EWRA Risk Register API
info.description:
Complete API test suite for the dooit.ai EWRA Risk Register module.

Covers: generate, list, retrieve, update, manual override, recalculate, submit, approve, export, and delete.

Real-data scenario: **Smith & Associates Lawyers Pty Ltd** — a mid-sized law firm (Lawyers/Conveyancers, Tranche 2) with face-to-face and online delivery, domestic PEP exposure, high-value unfinanced property transactions, and occasional cash handling.

## Auth
Run **Login** first to capture the `token` variable. All other requests use Bearer `{{token}}`.

## Flow
1. Login → token captured
2. Create Risk Register → `registerId` captured
3. List / Get / Update / Recalculate / Patch Scenario / Submit / Approve / Export / Delete
